title: Untrusted one-shot activation relay in the Nitro parent
$comment: CIDs must be distinct and the decimal deadline must fit u64 and be future in the actual parent BOOTTIME clock. Both ports are source-fixed 9102. One caller connection is forwarded to one service-enclave connection, with bounded BE32 framing and EOF in each direction. No TCP target, private key, descriptor transfer, retry or routing-as-identity claim. Existing native signatures, C9 delivery, NSM, journal and original signed expiry remain independently required.
